name: Distributed 3DGS Training Loop with Adaptive Workload Division
definition: A distributed training workflow for 3D Gaussian Splatting that batches camera selection, divides rendering workloads across GPUs using an adaptive strategy history, synchronizes losses, and schedules densification and SH degree updates.
summary: This method distributes 3D Gaussian Splatting training across GPUs, using adaptive workload division and optional gradient scaling to dynamically balance rendering loads and avoid explicit accumulation buffers.
